Item.Name: Description
Item.Value: Stores the AI evaluation (score, recommendation, summary, strengths, concerns) on the application and shortlists strong candidates.

Item.Name: Parameters.ApplicationReference.Sys_Description
Item.Value: Id (GUID) or name of the recruitment application (EmpoApplication) to work with.

Item.Name: Parameters.Concerns.Sys_Description
Item.Value: Bullet list of gaps, risks or questions to probe in the interview.

Item.Name: Parameters.Recommendation.Sys_Description
Item.Value: One of: Strong fit, Good fit, Possible fit, Not a fit.

Item.Name: Parameters.Strengths.Sys_Description
Item.Value: Bullet list of the candidate strengths against the requirements.

Item.Name: Parameters.Summary.Sys_Description
Item.Value: 2-4 sentence evaluation summary for the hiring team.
